PROXY STATEMENT OF THE TRIAN GROUP
PLEASE VOTE THE ENCLOSED BLUE PROXY CARD FROM TRIAN TODAY.
This proxy statement and the enclosed BLUE proxy card are being furnished to shareholders in connection with the solicitation of proxies by Trian Partners, L.P. and affiliates to be used at the 2026 annual meeting of shareholders of Disney.
THIS SOLICITATION IS BEING MADE BY THE TRIAN GROUP AND NOT ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE COMPANY.
Proposal 1: Election of Nelson Peltz and James A. Rasulo to serve as directors of the Company for a term of one year.
The Trian Group is seeking your proxy to vote FOR the election of each of the Trian Nominees and to WITHHOLD on each of the Opposed Company Nominees.
The Company and other parties may use a WHITE proxy card or a GREEN proxy card.
